Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd is a chemical enterprise located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone of Binzhou City, Shandong Province, China. Situated in a well-established industrial area with convenient logistics and supporting infrastructure, the company focuses on the development, manufacturing, and application of cyclodextrin-based products and related derivatives. Cyclodextrins are widely used as functional molecules to improve solubility, stability, and delivery of active ingredients, which makes them valuable in a range of downstream industries, including pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, daily chemicals, agriculture, and industrial formulations.

With an emphasis on technology-driven production and consistent quality management, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd works to provide reliable products and customized solutions that meet different customer requirements. The company’s operations typically cover product research and optimization, process control, and technical service to support clients in formulation and application development. By leveraging regional manufacturing advantages in Shandong and maintaining a customer-oriented approach, the company aims to supply both domestic and international markets with stable, competitive cyclodextrin materials.

Guided by principles of safety, quality, and sustainable development, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd continues to expand its capabilities and strengthen collaboration with partners across the value chain, striving to be a trusted supplier in the cyclodextrin and specialty chemical sector.
